atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines Tailwind's design tokens as CSS variables. `@theme inline` emits the variables without wrapping them in a `:root` layer, so they resolve against values defined later in the file.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Registers a custom variant, e.g. `@custom-variant dark (&:is([data-theme$='dark'] *));`.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines the declarations of existing utility classes into a custom rule.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Registers a custom utility that works with Tailwind's variants.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant to styles in your own CSS.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Adds a path for Tailwind's class detection to scan, beyond what it finds automatically.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript-based Tailwind plugin.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript config file, as this project does for `tailwind.config.mjs`.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Imports a stylesheet for its theme/utility definitions only, so `@apply` works inside a file that isn't the main entry point.
